items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: I forget what drummer it was I reliefed there. He was an old time drummer. Oh yeah. It was Ernest Rogers, that's right.

ctx.x: Anything else you remember around in there or later on? Later on? Yeah, they had a lot of things happen. Well, you see a millen boy. Gee, that was New Orleans. New Orleans was New Orleans at that time. You see, modern times, I mean, it changed everything. They had a lot of camps. Just like they have now in some parts of Littlewood. You know, out on the lake, the camp's out on the lake. Well, that's... It was flooded out there with camps. And people had picnics every day. Every day. And when they had a picnic,…
The straight line on the bandstand, yeah. Well, you had the bass, then they had the guitar, the clarinet, the clarinet player, the trombone
